items.title: API create/list with parentId
steps: POST reply with parentId of that comment
POST reply with parentId of the reply (should fail)
GET comments; confirm parentId on views
items.expected: Valid reply 201; invalid parent 4xx; list includes parentId.
items.evidence: -tw API on disposable DB: parent+reply 201 with parentId set; nested reply to reply returned success:false COMMENT_VALIDATION "Parent must be a top-level comment on this post."; GET list includes parentId null/set correctly.

items.title: Reply button + inline composer + indent
items.precondition: Signed in; open a post with comments
steps: Confirm Reply is on the right of a top-level comment
Click Reply — inline composer appears under that parent with Replying to … + Cancel; scrolls into view
Submit reply — appears indented under parent
Use bottom form without reply target — new top-level comment
items.expected: Inline composer under parent (no modal); bottom form for top-level only; indent visible; Cancel clears reply target.
items.evidence: PostDetailPage.tsx: Reply button on parents; inline form when replyTo.id === parent.id with scrollIntoView(center); bottom form posts parentId null only. Docs/acceptance aligned Rev 6.
items.notes: Updated after PR review to match shipped inline UX (not fixed-bottom chip).

items.title: Chronological parent/child ordering
items.precondition: Two parents each with replies on isolated API
steps: Create Parent A, Parent B, then A reply 1, B reply 1, A reply 2
GET comments and group like SPA
items.expected: Parents oldest→newest; under each parent, replies oldest→newest.
items.evidence: PARENT_ORDER ['Parent A','Parent B']; UNDER Parent A -> ['A reply 1','A reply 2']; UNDER Parent B -> ['B reply 1'].
